message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Sun (孙) obtained five VAT special invoices that were fictitious (虚开) from a company, no real transaction, used them to claim tax deduction, defrauding tax of 77517.1 yuan. This is classic "虚开增值税专用发票罪" (crime of falsifying VAT special invoices) used for tax evasion. Also possibly "骗取国家税款" (tax evasion). In examples, they label as "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". So the label is "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". However here it's not export refund, just tax deduction. So likely "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取国家税款" but the pattern used earlier: "虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票". In many examples they use that phrase for similar. So answer: [罪名]虚开增值税专用发票、用于骗取出口退税、抵扣税款发票<eoa>. Possibly also "诈骗"? But the main is virtual invoice. So final answer.
